display.label: AWS NAT Gateway
display.description: Provision Amazon VPC NAT Gateways with zonal or regional availability modes for secure outbound internet traffic

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name and identifier for the NAT Gateway, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core NAT Gateway settings including name, availability mode, connectivity type, and target network placement.

fields.label: NAT Gateway Name
fields.description: Unique name for the NAT Gateway, applied as the 'Name' tag and map key.

validation.pattern_error: NAT Gateway name must only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: Availability Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to create a zonal (single-AZ) or regional (multi-AZ) NAT gateway.

options.label: Zonal
options.description: Single-AZ NAT Gateway placed in a specific subnet within an availability zone.

options.label: Regional
options.description: Multi-AZ NAT Gateway that scales across availability zones within a VPC.

fields.label: Connectivity Type
fields.description: Connectivity type for the NAT Gateway.

options.label: Public
options.description: Internet-facing NAT gateway to route private subnet traffic to the internet.

options.label: Private
options.description: Internal NAT gateway for routing private traffic without an internet gateway (zonal mode only).

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: The Subnet ID of the subnet in which to place the NAT Gateway (required for zonal mode).

fields.label: VPC ID
fields.description: The ID of the VPC in which the regional NAT Gateway will be created (required for regional mode).

sections.label: IP Addressing & Elastic IPs
sections.description: Configure Elastic IP and private IPv4 allocation settings for zonal NAT gateways.

fields.label: Elastic IP
fields.description: The Elastic IP address for the NAT Gateway (required for public zonal NAT Gateways).

fields.label: Private IPv4 Address
fields.description: The private IPv4 address to assign to the NAT Gateway (zonal only). If omitted, an address is automatically assigned.

fields.label: Secondary EIP Allocation IDs
fields.description: List of secondary Elastic IP allocation IDs to associate with the NAT Gateway (zonal only).

fields.label: Secondary Private IPv4 Addresses
fields.description: List of secondary private IPv4 addresses to assign to the NAT Gateway (zonal only).

fields.label: Secondary Private IP Count
fields.description: Number of secondary private IPv4 addresses to assign to the NAT Gateway (zonal and private only).

sections.label: Regional Multi-AZ Settings
sections.description: Configure availability zones and Elastic IP mappings for manual regional NAT gateway mode.

fields.label: Availability Zone Address Mappings
fields.description: Repeatable mappings of Elastic IP allocations to specific availability zones for regional NAT gateways.

fields.label: Allocation IDs
fields.description: List of Elastic IP allocation IDs to be used for handling outbound NAT traffic in this specific Availability Zone.

fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.description: Availability Zone (e.g. us-east-1a) where this specific NAT gateway configuration will be active.

fields.label: Availability Zone ID
fields.description: Availability Zone ID (e.g. use1-az1) where this specific NAT gateway configuration will be active.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organizational, tracking, and cost allocation purposes.

fields.label: NAT Gateway Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the NAT Gateway.
